title: Decoration Outage During Prime Hours
dataSources: Decoration timers (`holidaytimer:event`), birthday spending (`birthday:spend`), and fireworks noise events (`fireworks:noise`).
app: Seasonal household telemetry from decoration timers, birthday spending trackers, and fireworks noise sensors sent to Splunk HEC via Home Assistant, budget exports, and scripted inputs.
spl:
index=personal sourcetype=holidaytimer:event
| search prime_hour=true
| bin _time span=1w
| stats count as attempts count(eval(powered="true")) as successful by _time zone_name
| eval success_pct=if(attempts>0,round(100*successful/attempts,1),0)
| sort - _time
description: Tracks success rate for prime-hour decoration uptime by zone.
value: Prime-hour uptime is the moment that matters most if the display is meant to be seen and enjoyed.
implementation: Capture explicit outcome states for prime-hour decoration uptime events in `index=personal` and review both attempts and success percentage over time.
visualization: Time chart of success percentage for prime-hour decoration uptime by zone.
grandmaExplanation: It reminds how often prime-hour decoration uptime works the way you expect instead of quietly failing.
